# Sravya Tech Rentals
> Bangalore's trusted partner for IT & AV equipment rentals. Commercial printers, laser projectors, projector screens, and PA sound systems across Bangalore with same-day delivery, verified equipment, and full on-site setup support.

## Services & Inventory
- [Commercial Printers & Copiers](https://sravya-tech-rentals.vinaykumarsrinivas1980.workers.dev/#brands): Multifunction office copiers and printers (Canon, Epson, Brother, HP, Xerox) with flexible daily, weekly, and monthly corporate leases.
- [Laser & 4K Projectors](https://sravya-tech-rentals.vinaykumarsrinivas1980.workers.dev/#brands): High-lumen office, conference, and event projectors (Epson, BenQ, Acer, ViewSonic).
- [Tripod & Motorized Projector Screens](https://sravya-tech-rentals.vinaykumarsrinivas1980.workers.dev/#features): 6x4 ft to 10x8 ft high-gain projection screens for corporate meetings, classroom workshops, and private screenings.
- [PA Sound Systems & Microphones](https://sravya-tech-rentals.vinaykumarsrinivas1980.workers.dev/#brands): Premium audio setups (JBL, Sony, Panasonic, Philips) with wireless handheld and collar mics for seminars, weddings, and parties.
